basic_profile.bio: Born and raised in Brooklyn, I've been a die-hard Knicks fan since I was a kid. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to catch most games and engage with the community during late afternoons and evenings. I am single, and when I'm not working or watching basketball, I love exploring conspiracy theories and sci-fi series. My weekends are usually spent catching up on the latest space exploration news or playing Roblox with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, and my love for basketball has led me to become quite knowledgeable about NBA history and statistics. I've taught myself a lot about space exploration through online courses and documentaries, and I enjoy discussing these topics with others.
